- **Kids & Me:** Halton Region's page gives the Thursday time at the Acton library branch. That page doesn't state an age range. The library's own page describes Kids & Me as a free weekly drop-in for families with babies or children up to 6, but it posts no day or time. The Region's page also lists a Monday 10 to 11:30 a.m. session at the Acton Community Hub.
- **EarlyON (Links2Care):** The page says the programs are free, drop-in, and run on weekdays, weekends and evenings. The snippet I could read had no specific day or time for a toddler group. A Links2Care fall schedule PDF showed Wee Ones (0–36 months) and Adult & Child Together (0–6) drop-ins, but its date was unclear, so I left it out. Check the Links2Care page for the current schedule.
